note: LA.17 (programme A10.13). Connect: the server registers `elizav1connect.NewElizaServiceHandler(&elizaServer{})` and implements Say; a Go client (`elizav1connect.NewElizaServiceClient(...)` then `client.Say(...)`) and a connect-es browser client (`createClient(ElizaService, transport)` then `client.say(...)`) call it. Procedures come from the build's .proto (ElizaService: Say, Introduce), keyed rpc:<proto package>.<Service>.<Method>, and pair through RpcStackResolver. Baseline 2026-09-18 (HEAD 7a4883b): no RPC_PROCEDURE / RPC_CALL at all; the Go client only surfaces as the service-level GRPC_CLIENT grpc_client:ElizaService (legacy `ServiceClient(` suffix), the TS client as nothing. Re-measured 2026-09-19 at f92d557 before LA.17 (grade.py, installed wheel): 3 nodes XX, HANDLED_BY 0/1, RPC_CALLS 0/1, USES 0/2, POSITION 0/1, 0 forbid violations.
